title: Mechanism claims: read-through session cache with revoke invalidation

defects.title: Claim 1 is false: a load that read the row before revoke repopulates the cache afterwards
defects.catch_criteria: The review must reject claim 1 and show the interleaving: an authorize call that missed the cache is awaiting store.find inside loadAndStore (cache.ts:37-39) with a row read before markRevoked; revoke (sessions.ts:34-36) then calls invalidate, which only deletes the entry and bumps the generation (cache.ts:32-34); when the load finishes, loadAndStore stores the stale non-revoked session anyway (cache.ts:40), because the generation is read after the await and get never compares generations (cache.ts:22-24), so authorize returns the revoked session until the 60-second TTL ends. Showing that a caller arriving during the load also joins the stale inflight promise (cache.ts:25-26) is an equivalent catch. The catch must name why the generation guard is ineffective or that invalidate does not touch the inflight load. A verdict of uncertain, or a refutation that only says caches can be stale, does not count.

review_prompt_hint: Verify the numbered behavioral claims in prompt.md one by one against the code. Scoring rules for this claim review: the review gives one verdict per claim, and a confirmed verdict is not a finding. Count as one unsupported finding each refuted or uncertain verdict on a claim that no listed defect covers, and each issue the review raises outside the numbered claims. The review assigns no severity, so rate every refuted verdict on a claim that no listed defect covers as P2.
